generate_openapi_schema_compat: generate an OpenAPI schema with compatibility handling for FastAPI 0.120+ Pydantic schema generation errors
patch_pydantic_unknown_type_schema: patch Pydantic's _unknown_type_schema to handle openai.Timeout and other non-serializable types gracefully
handle_openai_timeout_schema: handle openai.Timeout types by returning a string schema instead of raising PydanticSchemaGenerationError
fallback_openapi_schema_generation: fallback to normal OpenAPI schema generation when Pydantic patching is unavailable or fails
return_minimal_openapi_schema: return a minimal OpenAPI 3.0.0 schema with empty paths and components when schema generation fails
